Routes.description:
**Declarative mode.** Picks the best match among its `<Route>` children.
No loaders, actions or pending UI.

Route.description: **Declarative mode.** One route. Nest `<Route>` elements to build layouts, and render an `<Outlet />` in the parent.

Route index.description: **Declarative mode.** Renders at the parent's exact path. An index route takes no `path` of its own.

Route 404.description: **Declarative mode.** Catch-all for unmatched URLs. Put it last, at the top level.

import useRoutes.description: **Declarative mode.** Define routes as an object tree inside a component.

useRoutes().description:
**Declarative mode.** The hook form of `<Routes>`, taking plain objects instead of JSX.
No data loading.
